text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely avenge my frustration from 
last time.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I've got the mental image down. No matter 
how the race unfolds... I'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Because I've done sooo much 
training leading up to today."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I... believe in you. That much will never 
change.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"That's why we're going to win. —Together, 
combining both our strengths."
